detail.title: Establishing Project on Cross-Cultural Musical Structure
detail.summary: Pursuant to the Squirrel attention directive enforcing the music topic, we establish a new project investigating cross-cultural musical universals versus learned traditions, and initiate an initial search for empirical reviews.

detail.title: Cross-Cultural Musical Structure
detail.question: Which structural features of music appear across cultures, and which are strongly shaped by learned musical traditions?
detail.reason: Initiate a project on the enforced selected topic to investigate musical universals and cultural variation.
